mapper.select: SELECT PLACE_NO, PLACE_NAME, TRIM(ADDR || ' ' || NVL(ADDR_DETAIL, '')) AS ADDRESS, X_AXIS, Y_AXIS FROM PLACE WHERE PLACE_NO = #{placeNo} AND DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT PLACE_NO, PLACE_NAME, TRIM(ADDR || ' ' || NVL(ADDR_DETAIL, '')) AS ADDRESS, X_AXIS, Y_AXIS FROM PLACE WHERE DEL_YN = 'N' AND INSTR(UPPER(PLACE_NAME), UPPER(#{query})) > 0 ORDER BY CASE WHEN UPPER(PLACE_NAME) = UPPER(#{query}) THEN 0 WHEN INSTR(UPPER(PLACE_NAME), UPPER(#{query})) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, PLACE_NAME, PLACE_NO FETCH FIRST 15 ROWS ONLY
